flora: Redwood cone (small, round/globose with peltate scales)
Feathery foliage (flat, linear needles arranged oppositely on the twig)
Redwood sapling (tapered 'Christmas tree' shape with reddish-brown bark)
Bark detail (fibrous, stringy reddish-brown bark with vertical shredding)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; emphasis on the soft, feathery texture of the needles and the stringy, fibrous bark; clear quadrant separation for educational study.

visual_logic.composition: A quadrant tiled composition: Top-Left: A single small round cone; Top-Right: A close-up spray of flat, feathery needles; Bottom-Left: A symmetrical young sapling; Bottom-Right: A high-detail view of the fibrous, shredding bark.
visual_logic.ground: Dark, damp organic mudstone with small grey siltstone pebbles.
visual_logic.lighting: Clear, even, bright diffused daylight to capture the fine detail of the needle arrangements.
